Which of the following gives the covariance of $X$ and $Y?$

Question 5
?

The joint probability mass function f(x,y) for the discrete random variables X and Y with joint support S=SX×SY is given below.

f Y=2 Y=5
X=1 0.12 0.4
X=3 0.28 0.2

Which of the following gives the covariance of X and Y?

a
∑(x,y)∈Sx(y−1)f(x,y)
b
 ∑(x,y)∈S(xy−1.96)f(x,y)
c
 ∑(x,y)∈S(x−3.8)(y−1.96)f(x,y)
d
 ∑(x,y)∈S(x−1)(y−2)f(x,y)
e
∑(x,y)∈S(x−1.96)(y−3.8)f(x,y)
Submit
